paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness plugin for Sub2api account quotas and usage monitoring
# sub2api Account Usage Monitor
English | 中文
`dsh-sub2api-monitor` is a DSH desktop plugin compatible with DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`. It
provides only a usage entry in the conversation title bar, with no sidebar entry, full page, or cent
ered dialog. The title-bar popover has a maximum width of 700px and adapts to the viewport, balancin
g two-column cards with readability. Clicking outside, pressing Esc, or clicking Close dismisses it;
clicking inside does not. It does not modify DSH core or start additional processes or HTTP service
licking inside does not. It does not modify DSH core or start additional processes or HTTP services.
## Data and refresh
The Host reads the paginated account list, each account's `/usage`, and `/today-stats` through the m
anagement API. It refreshes every 60 seconds by default, processing at most 3 accounts concurrently.
The Client reads the local cache every 10 seconds; manual refresh has a minimum interval of 10 seco
nds. All timers and requests are disposed of on plugin unload. Operations are read-only: the plugin
does not call account start/stop, credential refresh, or quota-reset endpoints.
- Quota windows: 5-hour, 7-day, and upstream Sonnet/Opus windows, showing usage percentages and rela
tive reset times, with full timestamps on hover. Anthropic explicitly uses `source=passive`, matchin

g the site's passive sampling; the default active endpoint may omit weekly quotas.
- Compact, respon
sive cards retain today's statistics and abbreviate large numbers. The top explanation area and sear

ch box are removed; synchronization status appears as a title-bar dot.
- Subscription type: only all
owlisted scalar values from `credentials.plan_type` are extracted, displayed separately from authent
ication methods such as OAuth. `promax` is shown as the site's corresponding `Pro 500`; missing valu

es display “Unknown subscription”. The credentials object is never passed through.
- Today's request
s, tokens, and cost use the Shanghai time zone. Costs use sub2api's accounting basis and are not equ

ivalent to the provider's actual bill.
- Highlights at 80%/95%; the conversation summary counts acco

unts needing attention. System notifications are not currently sent.
- Unknown fields remain unknown
. Partial failures are marked separately; list failures retain old data with a stale indicator. Upst
ream snapshots may predate collection; source timestamps are shown when supplied by the API.
## Account details
Click a card (or press Enter/Space) to open details within the same popover; Back returns to the lis
t. Details load `/admin/accounts/:id/stats?days=30&timezone=Asia%2FShanghai` only on demand, cache f
or 60 seconds, and coalesce concurrent requests. Only known collected account IDs are accepted, redi
rects are rejected, and the Host projects allowlisted fields. No historical database or background h
istory polling is added.
The view shows period totals, reported window length and recorded date range, daily request/Token/ac
count-cost bars, model ranking by Token with expandable input/output/cache composition, active-day a
verages, peak days, and mean request duration. Missing dates are not filled with zeros. This covers
only calls through sub2api; costs are not subscription bills, and mean duration is not time to first
token. Account costs use `actual_cost` for daily records and `account_cost` for models; missing fie
lds stay unknown. Errors offer retry; leaving details aborts the UI request, while shared Host work
is bounded by timeout and unload cancellation.
## Installation and plugin configuration
Install the npm package `dsh-sub2api-monitor` in DSH's Plugins page. Open the configuration form in
the plugin details, fill in the following fields, and save. Configuration is embedded directly in th
e plugin information page rather than registering a host settings page; the Configuration button at
the top of the usage popover also opens it. DSH's settings service writes configuration to the profi
le; no plugin source edits are needed. The read endpoint returns only non-sensitive fields, the cred
ential reference name, and whether a key is set. Leaving the key input blank preserves the existing
value; the first save requires a key. Saves use revisions to detect concurrent conflicts and do not
automatically overwrite changes from another window.
Disable the old `sub2api-monitor` and earlier `myspace-sub2api-monitor` packages before enabling the
new package to avoid duplicate collection. After moving parameters into plugin configuration, unins
tall the old package. Both the component ID and configuration namespace are `dsh-sub2api-monitor`; c
onnection configuration is managed only by the DSH profile. When upgrading to 0.1.0, also replace th
e old component ID in the profile with the new ID while preserving its config fields; do not just sw
ap packages and lose configuration.

- `baseUrl`: the site's API address, including `/api/v1`.
- `adminApiKeyEnv`: credential reference (
environment-variable-style name) for the administrator API key; default `SUB2API_ADMIN_API_KEY`. The
profile stores only this name. A key entered in the form is written to the DSH credentials service
(`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` with the local provider), not to plugin configuration. The process en
vironment or a `.env` file can also supply it; an inherited environment value is read-only and disab

les the key input.
- `allowInsecureHttp`: off by default; enable only after explicitly accepting pla

intext risks.
- `intervalSeconds`: 30–3600 seconds; default 60 seconds.

## Installation and verification
The only dependency is the official `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` configuration schema package; there i
s no generation step. The Client is JavaScript wrapped in the native ModuleLoader and ships directly
in the package. Install the npm package or a development-directory link bundle through DSH plugin m
anagement. Restart DSH after upgrading an installed module, then check the bilingual titles, icon, c
onfiguration form, and conversation summary in plugin details. There is no need to start a replaceme
rm, and conversation summary in plugin details. There is no need to start a replacement Web service.
This is a community plugin, not an official DeepSeek product. Package metadata, icon exports, biling
ual locales, native Config, and lifecycle follow the DSH plugin specification. The original transpar
ent SVG icon uses a 36×36 dashboard design. Source and issue tracker: https://github.com/fegnze/dsh-
s a 36×36 dashboard design. Source and issue tracker: https://github.com/fegnze/dsh-sub2api-monitor.
